posts.title: gg, week 16: Harbinger, particles, and an animation graph
posts.description: The jam gets a second run and turns into a game worth keeping, which drags particles, an animation graph, retargeting and decals into the engine behind it.

posts.title: gg, weeks 12 to 15: rain, snow, lightning, and back on the 3070
posts.description: Back on the desktop: the weather starts dropping things, the goldens move onto the GPU, a scene gets more than one body to steer, and leaves hang off branches.

posts.title: gg, weeks 8 to 11: a pond, fog, night, and a month on a laptop
posts.description: Four weeks on a laptop with an integrated GPU: the pond gets a surface, fog becomes a medium, the goldens leave git, and night stops being black.
